use_when: 场景化视觉
人脸活体检测
证件识别
文档扫描

在商品搜索页面接入 Vision Kit 的 AI识图控件（visionImageAnalyzer），从用户拍摄的商品图片中识别主体并发起识图搜索 / Integrate Vision Kit's AI image recognition control (visionImageAnalyzer) on a product search page to identify the main subject in a user-captured product photo and start visual search
如何实现人脸活体检测，通过引导用户完成指定动作验证真实身份？
如何使用卡证识别功能提取身份证、银行卡、护照等证件的结构化信息？
如何实现文档扫描，自动裁剪并生成高清扫描件？
如何使用文档扫描的表格识别功能生成可编辑的表格文档？
如何使用AI识图控件实现OCR文本识别？
如何使用AI识图控件实现主体分割（抠图）功能？
如何使用AI识图控件实现识图搜索功能？
如何在考勤打卡、辅助登录场景中集成活体检测？
如何在金融开户场景中实现身份证信息自动采集？
当你的应用需要进行身份真实性验证时，例如在线开户、远程签约、考勤打卡等场景，你应该使用 Vision Kit 的人脸活体检测能力
该能力可以有效防止照片攻击和视频回放攻击，确保用户身份的真实性
当你的应用需要处理证件信息录入或文档数字化时，例如开户时的身份证信息采集、报销时的发票和文档扫描、商品搜索时的图片识别等场景，你应该使用 Vision Kit 的卡证识别、文档扫描或 AI 识图能力
这些能力可以大幅减少用户的手动输入工作量，提升应用的交互体验和数据采集效率
集成人脸动作活体校验完成实名验证流程 / Integrate face liveness action checks for real-name identity verification
识别身份证护照银行卡并自动回填表单信息 / Recognize ID cards, passports, and bank cards to auto-fill form fields
扫描纸质文件并自动矫正裁边生成清晰PDF或图片 / Scan paper documents with auto crop and perspective correction to generate clear PDFs or images
提取扫描表格内容并导出为可编辑电子表格 / Extract scanned table content and export it as an editable spreadsheet
在拍照后做OCR文字识别并复制或搜索内容 / Run OCR on captured images so text can be copied or searched
实现图片主体分割抠图并替换背景 / Perform subject segmentation to cut out a person or object and replace the background
接入拍图识物或识图搜索能力返回相似结果 / Add visual search from a photo and return similar matches
获取证件上的姓名证号有效期等结构化字段 / Extract structured fields like name, ID number, and expiry date from identity documents
在开户审核流程中自动检测证件边框并采集清晰证件照 / Detect document edges and capture a clear ID photo in onboarding flows
实现移动端文档拍摄增强去阴影去反光 / Enhance mobile document capture by removing shadows and glare
用AI视觉组件完成文本识别、抠图和搜图入口 / Use AI vision widgets for OCR, cutout, and image search entry points
在门禁考勤或登录场景中接入刷脸活体检测 / Integrate face liveness detection for access control, attendance, or login
读取票据合同表单图片并识别其中的文字与表格 / Read receipt, contract, or form images and recognize their text and tables
do_not_use_when: 需求是将中文音频离线转写为文字，或进行多音色中英文语音合成朗读，应改用 core-speech-kit / The requirement is offline Chinese audio transcription or multi-voice Chinese and English speech synthesis; use core-speech-kit instead

需求是部署并优化端侧神经网络模型，进行模型转换、轻量训练，或通过ArkTS与Native接口完成推理集成，应改用 mindspore-lite-kit / The requirement is to deploy and optimize on-device neural models, perform model conversion or lightweight training, or integrate inference through ArkTS and Native interfaces; use mindspore-lite-kit instead
preconditions: 工程已集成 Vision Kit 对应能力，并且目标设备/系统版本支持所选视觉服务 / The project has integrated the Vision Kit capability and the target device/system version supports the selected visual service
应用已在 module.json5 中声明并获得所需权限（如相机、照片访问等） / The app has declared and obtained required permissions in module.json5, such as camera and photo access
涉及拍摄、证件识别或文档扫描时，设备相机可正常使用且用户已授权 / For capture, ID recognition, or document scanning, the device camera is available and user authorization has been granted
输入的图片、视频或控件宿主组件可被应用正常访问，且格式符合对应接口要求 / Input images, videos, or host UI components are accessible to the app and their formats meet the relevant API requirements
inputs: 图像、视频帧或相机采集内容 / Image, video frames, or camera-captured content
待识别的证件或文档内容 / ID card or document content to be recognized
AI识图控件宿主组件或界面上下文 / AI image analyzer host component or UI context
所选视觉任务类型与相关配置参数 / Selected visual task type and related configuration parameters
outputs: 人脸活体检测结果对象（检测是否通过、失败/错误原因等） / Face liveness detection result object (pass/fail status, failure/error reason, etc.)
卡证OCR结构化识别结果（身份证、银行卡、护照、驾驶证、行驶证等字段信息） / Structured card OCR recognition results (fields from ID cards, bank cards, passports, driver licenses, vehicle licenses, etc.)
自动裁剪和增强后的文档扫描图片 / Auto-cropped and enhanced document scan images
文档扫描生成的PDF文件 / PDF file generated from document scanning
表格识别生成的可编辑表格文档 / Editable spreadsheet document generated from table recognition
AI识图OCR文本识别结果（文本内容、文本区域/坐标等） / AI image analyzer OCR text recognition results (recognized text, text regions/coordinates, etc.)
主体分割结果（主体掩膜、抠图结果或前景图像） / Subject segmentation result (subject mask, cutout result, or foreground image)
识图搜索结果（识别到的实体、目标或相关搜索信息） / Image search results (recognized entities, objects, or related search information)

postconditions.statement: 已在代码或界面流程中接入明确的 Vision Kit 场景化能力（如活体检测、卡证识别、文档扫描或AI识图） / A specific Vision Kit scenario-based capability has been integrated into code or UI flow, such as liveness detection, card recognition, document scanning, or AI image analysis
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set clearly add or configure a Vision Kit feature/API/component for one of these tasks: liveness detection, card recognition, document scanning, or AI image analyzer?

postconditions.statement: 输入媒体或界面组件已与所选视觉能力正确绑定，形成可执行调用链路 / The input media or UI component is correctly bound to the selected visual capability, forming an executable invocation flow
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is there a clear wiring from image/video/camera input or host component to the corresponding Vision Kit invocation or component usage?

postconditions.statement: 工程中已补充该视觉能力运行所需的关键声明或权限处理 / The project includes the key declarations or permission handling required to run the chosen visual capability
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits add or reference the necessary permissions, capability setup, or runtime authorization handling needed for the selected Vision Kit feature?
